scene:
Three areas side by side, read left to right. Do not write any title or heading above any area.

On the left: an open ledger book, its page ruled into three columns with one drawn object under each heading. Column headings: COST CARRIED (a stack of coins and a small clock beneath it), RISK CARRIED (a cracked shield beneath it), SPEED LOST (an arrow blocked by a small brick wall beneath it).

In the centre: two horizontal timelines stacked one above the other, both running left to right.
Upper timeline: one single long ochre bar across the whole width, labelled REWRITE €340K at its left end; over the middle of the bar a padlocked old machine with ice crystals, labelled FROZEN; at the far right end of the bar one star-shaped benefit burst labelled BENEFIT MONTH 9.
Lower timeline: two short teal bars with a gate drawn between them. The first short bar at the left is labelled TRANCHE 1 €58K and ends with a small star-shaped benefit burst labelled BENEFIT MONTH 3. Then a small garden gate standing upright on the line, labelled GATE 31 MAR 2028. After the gate, the second short bar labelled TRANCHE 2 €80K.

On the right, two cards stacked. Upper card: a report document with a calendar and a small padlock shield, marked with a large ochre number-free badge in the shape of a first-place ribbon, labelled REPORTING FIRST. Lower card: a person carrying a backpack of bricks while checking a written note and a clock, labelled CARRIED ON PURPOSE.

TEXT: draw exactly these labels, each once and nothing else: COST CARRIED, RISK CARRIED, SPEED LOST, REWRITE €340K, FROZEN, BENEFIT MONTH 9, TRANCHE 1 €58K, BENEFIT MONTH 3, GATE 31 MAR 2028, TRANCHE 2 €80K, REPORTING FIRST, CARRIED ON PURPOSE. No headings or titles of any kind, no numbers on the ribbon, no writing on the ledger page or the note beyond the three column headings. Any other text is a defect.
alt: A register page with three columns, cost carried, risk carried and speed lost, above two timelines: a rewrite as one long bar with a frozen engine, €340K, and its only benefit at month nine, against a tranche plan of two short bars, tranche 1 at €58K with its benefit at month three and tranche 2 at €80K, separated by a gate on 31 March 2028; a side card shows reporting first, and a scale shows debt carried on purpose.
caption: Three columns per debt item, a rewrite that pays only at the end against gated tranches that pay as they go, the close deadline handled first, and debt carried on purpose.
